notes: Overtime requests aTAS sends to HR by itself are marked "Sent automatically" (in your list and in manager Approvals).
History shows each day's overtime and when it was clocked, worded as aTAS Cloud: for example "Overtime 1 h 30 m paid · 17:30–19:00" or "Overtime clocked 1 h 30 m, not approved".
History's break now includes time away between a check-out and a check-in, and a forgotten OT Out is pointed out, as on the aTAS Cloud board.

Calculations follow aTAS Cloud's latest rules: with no break punched, half the shift or less on site takes no break off and is a half day; a half day without approved half-day leave shows "Half Day (not approved)".
